# Playbook snapshot (GitBook stub)

Qualitative rules only. This file must not be treated as a source of indicator values.

This fixture is **not** a GitBook mirror. Production doctrine is live GitBook +
PRIMETRADING_RULEBOOK_DISTILLATION.md + PrimeTrading_Ebook.pdf (see docs/CORPUS.md).

- Prefer trade_log evidence over journal over gameplan over evening report over this playbook.
- If the tape is a trend day, wait for reclaim before adding.
- If citations lack timestamps, abstain.
- If the feed is stale or audit is missing, abstain (fail-closed).
- Kill switch always wins.
- Conflicts (no-trade then entries; shorts vs rulebook default) are first-class labels.
